name: PURSUITCORE
desc:
This game is work in progress, expect bugs and unfinished stuff.
WARNING: This game has some flashing colors and fast-paced imagery, which may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

Survive & escape in a team of up to 7 Users, or kill them all as the Terminator.

OC Asymmetrical game heavily inspired by Sonic.EXE: The Disaster by OutLaik with some unconventional elements to it.
